query:
WITH RECURSIVE task_subtree AS (
                   SELECT id FROM tasks WHERE id = $1 AND group_id = $2
                   UNION ALL
                   SELECT tasks.id
                   FROM tasks
                   JOIN task_subtree ON tasks.parent_id = task_subtree.id
               )
               SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM task_subtree WHERE id = $3) AS "is_contained!"
